product.title: Core features
product.lead: Phone records. Cloud transcribes. Computer receives.
product.main_body: Tap to start recording, tap to stop. VoiceBridge transcribes in the cloud and delivers text directly to the active input field on your computer — no window switching.
product.aux1_body: Sign in on multiple computers with the same account. Your phone auto-discovers all online devices — pick a target and send.
product.aux2_body: When auto-paste isn't available, text is still copied to your computer's clipboard. Nothing is lost.

commands.title: Long text, one phrase
commands.lead: Save repetitive content as commands. Say a phrase and get the whole thing typed out.

how.title: Get started in 3 steps
how.step1_body: Visit on your phone's browser. Sign up or log in.
how.step2_body: Sign in with the same account. Connect multiple computers.
how.step3_body: Choose a computer on your phone, tap to record, and text lands right at that cursor.

download.title: Choose your desktop app
download.lead: macOS and Windows. Install on multiple computers.
download.free_note: Free plan available. No credit card required.
